hero.body: Archivato interviews you about your app, then generates the whole blueprint — requirements, architecture, database, API, a scored review, and a build roadmap. You edit, refine, and export. Not a chatbot; an architecture engine.
hero.demoCaption: A looping demo — watch an idea become a complete system design.

pipeline.title: One idea flows through eight gated stages.
pipeline.body: The core stages run as a gated trunk — nothing generates until the stage before it exists and you've confirmed the interview. Two standalone views branch off: Product Vision from the interview, and the Roadmap from the finished design.

interview.desc: Adaptive Q&A until requirements are complete — then you confirm.

productVision.label: Product Vision

roadmap.desc: The finished design sequenced into phases → milestones → tasks.

features.title: A full design studio, not a single answer.
features.body: Every stage produces a real, editable artifact — and the standalone views (vision, roadmap, review) frame it for the people who need them.

capture.label: Turn an idea into a spec

interview.title: Adaptive AI interview
interview.body: A phased interview clarifies your idea — goals, users, rules, scale, and tech — until requirements are complete. Then it waits for your confirmation.

requirements.title: Formal requirements
requirements.body: Functional & non-functional requirements, user roles with permissions, business rules, constraints, and assumptions — as a structured document.

vision.title: Product Vision
vision.body: A PM view of the confirmed interview: north-star vision, goals, a lean MVP vs. a future roadmap, success metrics, and user personas.

systemDb.title: System & database design
systemDb.body: An architecture (pattern, tech stack, services) and a schema — entities, keys, and relationships — derived from the requirements.

api.title: REST API design
api.body: Endpoints grouped by module with request/response schemas and status codes, plus a live OpenAPI/Swagger view.

diagrams.title: Diagrams & interactive canvas
diagrams.body: Auto-generated Mermaid diagrams plus a React-Flow canvas you can rearrange — edits save back to the same design.

roadmap.title: Implementation roadmap
roadmap.body: The whole design sequenced into ordered phases → milestones → tasks, with rough effort estimates and dependencies.

review.title: AI Architect Review
review.body: A scored critique across security, scalability, performance, and cost — with an overall score, per-dimension sub-scores, and critical-issue callouts.

refine.title: Refine by chat
refine.body: Change the design in plain language after generation. Every change is versioned, so you can compare and restore any point.

editors.title: Structured editors
editors.body: Every artifact is directly editable through structured forms — not a wall of text — with unsaved-change guards.

export.title: Export anywhere
export.body: Download the whole system as JSON, Markdown, OpenAPI, or a ready-to-scaffold project structure.

secure.title: Secure by default
secure.body: JWT + rotating refresh in httpOnly cookies, email verification, OAuth, and per-project ownership on every route.

how.title: From a sentence to a shippable design.

1.title: Describe the idea
1.body: Type a sentence about the software you want. Add an industry or scale if you like.

2.title: Answer the interview
2.body: The AI asks only what it needs, then summarizes. You confirm before any design begins.

3.title: Generate the system
3.body: Requirements, architecture, database, API, and a scored review — each stage builds on the last.

4.title: Refine, review & export
4.body: Tweak by chat or canvas, read the roadmap, then export to JSON, Markdown, OpenAPI, or a repo.

manifesto.titleLead: Most AI tools hand you a wall of text.
manifesto.titleAccent: Archivato hands you a system to build from.
manifesto.body: Structured, versioned, reviewable artifacts — the exact things an engineering team would actually build from.

footer.tagline: Turn a business idea into a complete software system design — not a chatbot, an architecture engine.
